Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_14960",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/ktar.cpp","function":"KTar::KTarPrivate::readHeader",
    "line":506,"var":"skip","code":"qint64 skip = size + (rest ? 0x200 - rest : 0);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"The tar header size field from compressed input determines skip distance for seek, which controls the overflow length"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/ktar.cpp","function":"KTar::KTarPrivate::readHeader",
    "line":508,"var":"dev->seek(dev->pos() + skip)","code":"if (! dev->seek(dev->pos() + skip))",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Calls KCompressionDevice::seek with a large position derived from the attacker-controlled size field"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::seek",
    "line":249,"var":"dummy","code":"QByteArray dummy(qMin(bytesToRead, qint64(3 * BUFFER_SIZE)), 0);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"dummy buffer is allocated as min(bytesToRead, 24KB) but read() is called with bytesToRead which may exceed 24KB; the missing safety obligation is that the read length must be <= allocated buffer size"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::seek",
    "line":250,"var":"bytesToRead","code":"const bool result = (read(dummy.data(), bytesToRead) == bytesToRead);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"read() is called requesting bytesToRead bytes into a buffer that may be smaller, leading QIODevice to call readData with maxlen > actual buffer size"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::readData",
    "line":280,"var":"maxlen","code":"filter->setOutBuffer(data, maxlen);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Sets zlib output buffer size to maxlen (bytesToRead) but data points to a buffer only min(bytesToRead,24KB) in size"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/kgzipfilter.cpp","function":"KGzipFilter::uncompress",
    "line":311,"var":"d->zStream","code":"int result = inflate(&d->zStream, Z_SYNC_FLUSH);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"zlib inflate/inflate_fast writes decompressed data past the end of the heap-allocated dummy buffer causing heap-buffer-overflow WRITE"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/ktar.cpp","function":"KTar::KTarPrivate::readHeader",
     "line":506,"operands":["skip","size"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::seek",
     "line":249,"operands":["bytesToRead","3 * BUFFER_SIZE"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"bytesToRead","right":"dummy.size()"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/kgzipfilter.cpp","function":"KGzipFilter::uncompress",
     "line":311,"operands":["d->zStream.next_out","d->zStream.avail_out"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"d->zStream.next_out + written","right":"dummy.data() + dummy.size()"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/ktar.cpp","function":"KTar::KTarPrivate::readHeader",
       "line":506,"operands":["skip"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::seek",
       "line":249,"operands":["bytesToRead"]},
      "type":"data","via":["dev->seek(dev->pos() + skip)"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"bytesToRead","right":"pos - d->deviceReadPos"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::seek",
       "line":250,"operands":["bytesToRead"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::readData",
       "line":280,"operands":["maxlen"]},
      "type":"data","via":["read(dummy.data(), bytesToRead)"],
      "relation":{"op":"gt","left":"maxlen","right":"dummy.size()"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/kcompressiondevice.cpp","function":"KCompressionDevice::readData",
       "line":280,"operands":["maxlen"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/kgzipfilter.cpp","function":"KGzipFilter::uncompress",
       "line":311,"operands":["d->zStream.avail_out"]},
      "type":"data","via":["filter->setOutBuffer(data, maxlen)"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"d->zStream.avail_out","right":"maxlen"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
